scope_notes: The SCAFFOLD in this paper is the explicitly simplified anchor-batch variant. It must not be conflated with 2503.07594 persistent centered xi, the original partial-participation SCAFFOLD, cached previous controls, or separate local/global step sizes.

All workers participate synchronously with equal weights, and stated independent Rademacher draws are conditioned on the listed realized sequence. This does not test a sampler, partial participation, client dropout or network scheduling.

Unequal quadratic Hessians are legal algorithm inputs but do not satisfy a globally bounded gradient-similarity constant over all R. The contract explicitly confines itself to the algorithm recursion, not every theorem hypothesis or speedup rate.

Four LocalSGD microsteps and eight simplified-SCAFFOLD microsteps only. Exact rational arithmetic rounded once to binary64 validates 1e-12 absolute/relative tolerances; no stochastic convergence conclusion.
